messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 INCIDENT detected: Spike in 5xxs for /v1/generate in us-west-2 during current canary rollout. Error rate ~18% over last 2m. Paging on-call. Runbook: <https://redwood/runbooks/deploy-failure|deploy-failure>
eli: Oncall taking. looking now. any customer-facing alerts yet? :eyes:
maria: I’m seeing a bunch of noisy alerts from the pager group — seems like both 5xx count and error budget alarms firing. dashboards for canary look weird though — graphs show gaps in traces around 12:16.
sanjay: I'm getting paged too. canary traffic is only ~5% of traffic but errors started after flagship model rollout 12:10. ashley rolled the flag at 12:09. ashley, did you change any routing?
ashley: rolled model v3 -> v4 canary at 12:08 via ffctl. no routing changes. quick diff of the feature flag: 
```
flag: model_rollout_v4
audience: 5% of prod
version: v4
metadata: region: us-west-2
```
ashley: no other changes.
eli: ok, first step: kill the flag for canary and fail back to v3. ashley, can you flip kill-switch? use /ff kill model_rollout_v4
ashley: running: `/ff kill model_rollout_v4 --reason "auto-rollback: 5xx spike"` — confirmed: flag disabled, traffic should route back to v3. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Rollback action recorded: model_rollout_v4 -> disabled by ashley at 2025-04-23T12:18:09Z
maria: after the kill, errors dropped on the service front-end but SLO burn alert still active and some dashboards still showing elevated error due to metric tagging mismatch. the canary metrics are being reported under metric name `inference.errors.v4` whereas alert queries expect `inference.errors` (no suffix). looks like v4 agent added a tag suffix. :facepalm:
sanjay: ah — that explains noisy alerts. because alert rules have strict metric names, both streams were triggering multiple alerts. we need a quick mitigation: either update alerts to union both metrics or add a temporary metrics alias in the exporter.
eli: short-term: mute the noisy pagers for the alertgroup (slo-error-pagers) for 15m so oncall can stabilize. I’ll annotate the incident. :mute:
product-aly: customers on Support are starting to notice increased latency and some failed calls around 12:15 — Support has one ticket from a mid-market customer. we should prepare a brief note.
maria: ops: quick patch — add a metric translation rule in prometheus relabel config so `inference.errors.v4` maps to `inference.errors` for alerting. I can push a on-the-fly relabel in the scrape gateway.
devex-nate: if you’re going to do relabel, remember remote-write requires restart. maybe easier to update alert queries to `inference.errors OR inference.errors.v4` for the alert group, then revert after we fix exporter.
eli: do that. ashley — can you update the alert rule in pagerduty temporarily? or grant maria permission to patch alert rule? we need minimal toil.
ashley: on it. editing alert rule: 
```
- alert: InferenceHigh5xx
  expr: sum(rate(inference.errors[1m])) > 0.01
+ expr: sum(rate(inference.errors[1m])) + sum(rate(inference.errors.v4[1m])) > 0.01
```
ashley: rule updated in staging -> promoting to prod now. applying.
ops-bot: Alert rule change deployed to monitoring cluster by ashley at 2025-04-23T12:24:12Z
maria: after rule change, raw alert flood subsided. SLO burn alarm still showing cumulative burn, but no new pagers in last 2m.
eli: good. action items for postmortem: 1) Exporter should not change metric names across model versions; 2) alert rules should be resilient to new metric suffixes (use label filters or regex). 3) Add a dashboard that compares metric name prefixes during rollouts.
product-aly: we also need a customer-facing blurb for Support: "We briefly saw increased failures in us-west-2 during a canary rollout at 12:10; rollback completed at 12:18; impact limited to a subset of requests; engineering is following up." I’ll draft.
sanjay: tracing gap root-cause: traces dropped because the v4 agent switched to a new trace tag key `trace_id_v4`, and our trace-aggregation job filters on `trace_id`. devex-nate, worth adding translation in the tracer pipeline.
devex-nate: yep, I can add a compatibility layer in the tracer aggregator to map `trace_id_v4` -> `trace_id` for the next deploy. will open PR and link.
eli: adding timeline to runbook: 
- 12:08 rollout start
- 12:10 errors begin
- 12:16 incident-bot auto-detect
- 12:18 feature flag killed by ashley
- 12:24 alert rule widened to include v4 metric
- 12:30 alerts stabilized, no new pagers

ashley: creating rollback postmortem draft now. linking to this thread.
maria: temporary mitigation: exporter patch to revert metric naming shipped to canary nodes; will schedule full invariant test for metric names in rollout pipeline.
product-aly: sending customer note now. tagging Support.
eli: ok team — keep monitor for 30m, then handoff to next on-call for follow-up. please add any follow-ups to the incident ticket: https://redwood/incidents/1755004321
incident-bot: Incident severity reduced to SEV2 at 2025-04-23T12:32:01Z — pager silenced. follow-up required: infra/monitoring postmortem.
eli: thanks everyone — good coordination. we should add a checklist item to rollout runbook: verify metric/trace key invariants before flag ramp. :memo:
